verdict.rationale: Terraform builds a dependency graph and parallelizes creation/modification of non-dependent resources, and can plan/apply/destroy across many resources in one declarative run, headlessly and machine-readably (JSON output, exit codes) as verified in hands-on probes. This directly enables bulk operations across many items at once, including CI-gateable, agent-parseable workflows. Missing for 10: independent large-scale (thousands-of-resources) benchmark evidence and explicit documentation of bulk state manipulation (e.g., bulk moved/import) beyond single-resource examples.
